title: Units Added by a Prior Authorization Extension
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension adds are the units asked for on the member's latest extension request on the authorization, less the units remaining on the authorization, never below zero and never more than the class's extension allotment.

- **Units asked for**: the additional units stated on the member's extension request on this authorization; where the member has filed more than one, the latest by date filed.
- **Units remaining**: the units-remaining balance shown on the authorization on the day of the extension.
- **Class's extension allotment**: the most units one extension may add in the authorization's Prior Authorization class.

The units asked for less the units remaining give the figure; a figure below zero is taken as zero, and a figure above the class's extension allotment is taken as the allotment.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, class extension allotment of 12 units)

| Units asked for | Units remaining | Units added |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 4 | 12 less 4, that is 8 |
| 20 | 2 | 20 less 2 is 18, held at the allotment of 12 |
| 6 | 9 | 6 less 9 falls below zero, so 0 |
| 12 | 0 | 12 |

Where the member filed one request for 10 units and a later one for 14 units, the units asked for are 14.
